text.arabic_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ

words.gloss_range: reclining or leaning as an accusative plural participial state attached to the already-known garden recipients
words.root_gloss_range: leaning, pressing, or resting weight on support; locally narrowed to supported repose in a reward scene
words.prose: {{ar:مُتَّكِـِٔينَ}} ({{tr:muttakiʾīna}}) opens with the recipients already in a circumstantial state: a plural group is seen reclining before any furniture or fruit is named. The root pressure image does not make the scene strenuous; it makes comfort bodily, because weight is transferred onto support. Its Form VIII shape and paradise-scene distribution make the posture voluntary, settled, and formulaic, with echoes such as 18:31 and the same-surah return at 55:76 reinforcing reclining as a reward marker. The standard hamza and variant smoothing mainly affect articulation, while the lexical payoff remains supported repose after the refrain of 55:53.

topics.headline: circumstantial plural reclining state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with an already-attached bodily state for the reward recipients, not with a newly named subject.
topics.reason: The accusative active participle is licensed as a circumstantial state, and the prior garden panel supplies the implied recipients.

topics.headline: root pressure becomes supported repose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reclining is not idle vagueness but a physical transfer of weight into a supporting surface.
topics.reason: The root family and the following surface phrase keep the pressure-support image concrete while the local sense remains comfortable reclining.

topics.headline: paradise posture formula with recitational pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this posture belongs to a recurring paradise register and that variants change the sound pressure, not the scene.
topics.reason: The occurrence and echo rows tie the participle to reward scenes such as 18:31 and 55:76, while the hamza rows concern articulation and derivational boundary.

words.gloss_range: preposition of on or upon, here making the couches the governed support surface
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) is the small hinge that turns reclining into a staged contact image. It governs the following plural noun and makes the furniture a bearing surface, not a container or a loose background. Because it comes immediately after the participle, the ayah moves from body to support before revealing the hidden lining.

topics.headline: preposition anchors reclining on a support surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the posture is physically anchored upon a surface rather than left spatially vague.
topics.reason: The particle governs the genitive complement and attaches the reclining state to a surface-contact support relation.

topics.headline: brief hinge from body to furniture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first micro-movement of the ayah: from the recliners to what bears them.
topics.reason: The particle completes the opening posture beat and audibly mediates between the long participle and the furnishing noun.

words.gloss_range: spread couches, bedding, or furnished support surfaces, indefinite plural and governed by the preceding preposition
words.root_gloss_range: spreading or laying out; locally narrowed to spread support surfaces for repose, with broader earth-spread and wing-spread associations kept secondary
words.prose: {{ar:فُرُشٍۭ}} ({{tr:furushin}}) names the support as an indefinite broken plural, so the scene gives abundant spread surfaces rather than one identified seat. The spread-root keeps the furniture flat, usable, and bodily, while the governed genitive role prevents it from becoming an independent clause subject. Its suffixal resumption by the next word lets the ayah move from the pictured outer support to the hidden interior. The contrast with 18:31 and the echo with 56:34 keep this as paradise furnishing language, but here the focus falls on spread couches whose unseen lining will be disclosed.

topics.headline: indefinite plural support surfaces
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the couches are plural, open-ended support surfaces governed by the preposition, not a named item of furniture standing alone.
topics.reason: Case, tanwīn, and broken plural form combine to make the furnishing abundant while keeping it dependent on the support preposition.

topics.headline: spread-root makes furniture a laid support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the furniture is imagined through spreading and laying out, so paradise comfort refines a broader surface image.
topics.reason: The local sense is furnishing, but root evidence keeps the spread-surface image active and narrows away unrelated root branches.

topics.headline: support noun anchors hidden lining disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the couches are immediately revisited through their hidden lining, making the next sentence a deepening of this noun.
topics.reason: The following suffix refers back to the non-human plural collectively, and the structure moves from support surface to inner lining.

topics.headline: rare furnishing term within paradise echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is not the throne-couch term of 18:31; it selects spread furnishings whose inner quality becomes central.
topics.reason: The row family links the root to rare furnishing usage, creation-surface language, and paradise parallels while preserving the local support-surface sense.

words.gloss_range: their inner linings, a plural lining noun with a suffix referring back to the couches
words.root_gloss_range: interiority, hiddenness, belly, lining, and intimate inside relation; locally narrowed to material inner linings of the couches
words.prose: {{ar:بَطَآئِنُهَا}} ({{tr:baṭāʾinuhā}}) turns the support surface inward. As the subject of a nominal sentence, it makes the hidden linings a standing fact, and the suffix keeps those linings bound to the couches already pictured. The root’s interior field is locally narrowed to material lining, but that narrowing is the point: the ayah reveals what is normally concealed. Because the inner side is named before the brocade material, the phrase creates an argument from the lesser: if the unseen lining is this luxurious, the unmentioned outer side is left to exceed explicit description.

topics.headline: linings as stable nominal subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brocade lining is presented as a standing property, not as an event or loose modifier.
topics.reason: The nominative noun is the subject of the material predicate, so the phrase first describes the linings themselves.

topics.headline: suffix binds hidden lining to prior couches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hidden interior belongs specifically to the couches just mentioned, held together by the suffix.
topics.reason: The suffix refers back to the prior non-human plural collectively, preserving continuity from support surface to lining.

topics.headline: interior root narrowed to material lining
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a broad hidden-inside root is focused into a tactile furniture interior without losing the concealedness payoff.
topics.reason: The root family spans bodily, social, and abstract interiors, but local furniture syntax selects the material lining sense.

topics.headline: hidden lining implies greater outer excellence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rhetorical force of naming the unseen side: the visible surface is implied to surpass what is stated.
topics.reason: The rows describe an argument from the lesser, where the explicitly named inner lining makes the omitted outer surface more impressive by inference.

topics.headline: interiority echoes and articulated break
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word participates in wider hidden/apparent and interiority echoes while its hamza makes the inward turn audible.
topics.reason: The cross-reference rows contrast interior uses such as 53:32 and 57:3, while the sound row supports an articulated shift into hidden lining.

words.gloss_range: preposition here specifying material composition for the inner linings
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) is not a vague origin marker here. It specifies material composition and governs the following textile noun, so the brocade belongs to the linings as their substance. Variant liaison can make the boundary sound more joined, but the grammatical payoff stays the same: the hidden interior is made of the named luxury material.

topics.headline: material particle specifies lining substance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle makes brocade the constituting substance of the linings, not a detached source phrase.
topics.reason: The grammar identifies the phrase as explanatory/material and governs the genitive textile noun.

topics.headline: attachment keeps material on inner lining
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the material phrase is routed to the hidden lining, sharpening the argument about unseen luxury.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the lining predicate primary, while any broader couch attachment is secondary.

topics.headline: recited liaison tightens the material phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitation can audibly fuse the particle to the textile while leaving the material relation intact.
topics.reason: The qiraat rows concern liaison and foreign-word boundary pressure, not a change in the material specification.

words.gloss_range: thick brocade, a foreign or naturalized luxury textile named as the material of the hidden linings
words.root_gloss_range: foreign-textile root or lexicalized loanword field; locally the word names thick brocade rather than activating unrelated Arabic root branches
words.prose: {{ar:إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ}} ({{tr:istabraqin}}) lands the lining sentence on a material: thick brocade. Its foreign or naturalized status and variant case behavior make the textile formally marked, while the standard reading still lets it function as a genitive noun under the material particle. The word is confined in the supplied evidence to paradise descriptions such as 18:31, 44:53, and 76:21, but 55:54 assigns it specifically to the hidden lining rather than to clothing. The shine and weight associations make the unseen layer both substantial and luminous, intensifying the implied excellence of the outer surface.

topics.headline: brocade scoped as lining material
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that brocade completes the hidden-lining predicate as material substance, not as an extra object in the scene.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the material particle and sits inside the predicate of the lining sentence.

topics.headline: foreign textile naturalized in Quranic phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the luxury term is formally marked as a borrowed or naturalized textile word, while local grammar still treats it as the material noun.
topics.reason: The foreign-word and diptote rows explain morphological pressure; they do not displace the local brocade sense.

topics.headline: heavy shining brocade in the hidden layer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hidden lining is not merely silk but a heavier, brilliant brocade, heightening the unseen luxury.
topics.reason: The semantic rows distinguish thick brocade from finer silk and allow a shine association without making etymology govern the parse.

topics.headline: paradise-only textile register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the textile belongs to a restricted paradise luxury register and is shifted here from garment imagery to furnishing architecture.
topics.reason: The occurrence rows place the word in paradise settings including 18:31, 44:53, and 76:21, with 55:54 using it for couch lining.

topics.headline: dense sound and liaison shape material weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word’s sound and boundary behavior reinforce the felt heaviness of the brocade phrase without changing syntax.
topics.reason: The rows concern onset, liaison, and consonant density; all preserve the material-predicate relation.

words.gloss_range: conjunction or circumstantial connector introducing the harvest-nearness clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots the ayah from the hidden-lining sentence to the harvest-nearness sentence. Its range allows coordination, resumption, or circumstantial simultaneity, so the fruit clause can be heard as an added provision fact or as provision present while reclining. In either case, the connector prevents the brocade sentence from absorbing the final clause and launches the movement from concealed interior to accessible abundance.

topics.headline: connector allows coordination or circumstance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final fruit clause is linked flexibly: added to the scene, resumed after it, or simultaneous with it.
topics.reason: The particle can mark coordination, resumption, or circumstantial relation, and local syntax licenses the final nominal clause without forcing only one nuance.

topics.headline: pivot from interior luxury to fruit access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah’s structural turn from concealed furnishing to accessible harvest.
topics.reason: The connector begins the coordinated provision beat after the lining predicate has been completed.

topics.headline: light proclitic launches final beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the small audible hinge that attaches directly to the harvest word and signals a fresh beat.
topics.reason: The written proclitic form and sound row support the clause-launch function.

words.gloss_range: harvest, gathered yield, or fruit-yield as the subject of the final nominal clause
words.root_gloss_range: picking, gathering, or what is gathered; locally narrowed to positive harvestable provision, not liability or offense
words.prose: {{ar:جَنَى}} ({{tr:janā}}) makes the final clause about harvestable yield. Grammatically it is the subject whose predicate is nearness, and its construct relation binds that yield to the two specific gardens. The verbal-noun shape compresses act and product: what could be picked is presented as gathered provision already within reach. Its rare root field, with 19:25 as the other supplied occurrence, makes the word load-bearing; the contrast is that Maryam’s fruit scene involves action, while here the harvest is simply near. Sound-nearness to the following garden word adds wordplay, but the roots remain distinct: yield comes from enclosure and lands in accessibility.

topics.headline: harvest is subject of the near predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that nearness is predicated of the harvest itself, making accessible yield the final claim.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the harvest phrase as subject and the final active participle as its predicate.

topics.headline: construct binds yield to the two gardens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the produce belongs to and comes from the specific garden pair, not from a generic fruit scene.
topics.reason: The construct relation keeps the gardens grammatically involved as the source or possessor of the yield.

topics.headline: gathering root becomes positive ready provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names harvestable yield with the act of gathering latent inside it, while the local paradise context excludes negative gathering.
topics.reason: The lexical rows allow harvest, gathered product, and even negative gathering elsewhere; local context narrows the field to positive provision.

topics.headline: rare root defined with 19:25 and 6:99 echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a rare harvest root is clarified by a small set of concrete produce scenes, especially 19:25 and 6:99.
topics.reason: The occurrence rows make this root rare and compare it with Maryam’s palm scene and earthly near-produce imagery.

topics.headline: harvest, garden, and nearness interlock in sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final clause tying harvest, enclosure, and nearness together through both sound and structure.
topics.reason: The rows preserve the phonetic thread with the following words while keeping the root distinction and final proximity predicate clear.

words.gloss_range: the two gardens, definite dual genitive in construct with the harvest noun
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, enclosing; locally selected as garden while retaining the productive-enclosure image
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-jannatayni}}) is not a generic plural of gardens. Its article and dual ending point back to the two gardens introduced at 55:46, while its genitive role makes them the source or possessor of the harvest. The root’s concealment field is locally selected as garden, yet it still matters: the harvest emerges from a protected enclosure. The dual also sustains the surah’s paired architecture, looking back to 55:46 and forward to 55:62, while the single harvest term and final nearness predicate keep the pair unified. Adjacent soundplay with the harvest word links yield and enclosure without collapsing their distinct roots.

topics.headline: definite dual points back to 55:46
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that these are the specific two gardens already introduced at 55:46, not gardens in general.
topics.reason: The definite article and dual morphology make the phrase anaphoric and preserve the garden-pair continuity.

topics.headline: genitive gardens source the harvest
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the harvest is grammatically tied to the gardens as source or possession before nearness is disclosed.
topics.reason: The genitive complement follows the harvest noun in construct and delays the predicate until the final word.

topics.headline: concealment root selected as productive garden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that garden here means an enclosed, protected source of yield, while unrelated concealment branches remain background.
topics.reason: The root family spans concealment meanings, but local noun sense and construct syntax select garden as productive enclosure.

topics.headline: dual pair structures the garden panel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the surah’s pairing pattern made concrete in this exact dual form, anchored at 55:46 and anticipating 55:62.
topics.reason: The dual form preserves pair-count and known reference inside the reward sequence.

topics.headline: garden root echoes brocade, reclining, nearness, and harvest sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the garden word sits inside a web of paradise cluster echoes and local harvest wordplay.
topics.reason: The rows link the garden root with 18:31, 6:99, and adjacent soundplay while maintaining local grammar.

words.gloss_range: near, close, accessible as an indefinite active participle predicate of the harvest
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, closeness, and related lower/near-world associations; locally selected as positive accessible proximity of harvest
words.prose: {{ar:دَانٍۢ}} ({{tr:dānin}}) is the ayah’s final disclosure: the harvest is near. Its masculine singular agreement targets the harvest, not the feminine dual gardens, and its predicate role makes proximity the claim that closes the scene. As an indefinite active participle, nearness is a standing, open quality of the yield rather than one identified object. The root can elsewhere carry the near/lower world association, but here it is revalued as privilege: distance and effort are removed. Echoes with near produce in 6:99, 69:23, and 76:14 keep a concrete low-hanging accessibility image, while the final tanwīn and cadence make access the audible endpoint of the ayah.

topics.headline: nearness predicates the harvest, not the gardens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that nearness belongs to the harvest itself, so the provision, not merely the place, is accessible.
topics.reason: Agreement and predication evidence attach the final word to the harvest subject rather than to the dual garden noun.

topics.headline: indefinite participle gives open standing nearness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that nearness is a continuing descriptive quality spread across the yield, not a single identified near object.
topics.reason: Tanwīn and active participle form make the predicate descriptive, broad, and durative.

topics.headline: near-world root revalued as paradise access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a root often associated with nearness or lower world here becomes honored accessibility.
topics.reason: The wider root field includes the near/lower world, but local paradise syntax selects positive proximity and effortlessness.

topics.headline: near produce echoes across worlds and paradise scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word belongs to a concrete near-produce motif, including earthly and paradise anchors such as 6:99, 69:23, and 76:14.
topics.reason: The echo rows compare earthly date clusters and paradise produce or shade while keeping the local predicate masculine for the harvest.

topics.headline: final cadence seals the ayah with access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the entire sequence lands on accessible nearness as the final word and final sound.
topics.reason: The structural and sound rows show delayed predicate placement, final tanwīn, and cadence focusing the ayah’s closure on access.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of reclining, spread bedding, gathered yield, and nearness.
baseline_models.mechanism: External supports remove bodily effort while the gardens' yield is brought into the recliners' reach. Rest and provision move in opposite directions: the people become still and abundance closes the distance.

activation_trace.role: Makes reclining an act of relying on an external support, removing the body's need to hold itself up.
Supplies a deliberately prepared resting surface rather than undifferentiated ground.
Makes the provision something gatherable and detachable from its place of growth.
Collapses the remaining interval between the supported body and the gathered provision.

changed_reading.before: A static inventory of luxurious furniture and fruit.
changed_reading.after: An ergonomic delivery scene in which support stills the recipients while provision advances into immediate reach.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Only the inner linings of the bedding are assigned a precious material, beside gardens whose very name carries concealment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The furnishing is treated as a layered object, yet the description bypasses its display face and names its concealed substrate. Hidden construction, hidden garden, and hidden inward reality make invisibility itself evidence of surplus: if the underside is silk, the unmentioned exterior need not advertise value.

activation_trace.role: Adds the material image of thin plates or layers, making the bedding readable as a constructed surface.
Locates the named silk on the concealed inner face of a covering rather than on its public surface.
Extends physical lining into an inward reality whose value is not exhausted by appearance.
Frames each garden as an enclosure hidden by its own dense trees, matching the inwardness of the bedding.

changed_reading.after: The concealed silk is an inside-out quality signal: the scene proves abundance by disclosing what ordinarily remains under cover.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The yield of the two gardens is presented together and made near.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two tree-covered enclosures feed one field of gatherable produce. The dual is therefore functional rather than merely scenic: distinct sources cooperate in making provision continuously proximate.

activation_trace.role: Treats yield as produce gathered from its living source and ready for transfer.
Supplies vigorous intertwined growth as the productive body behind both gardens' yield.
Turns the pair's distributed growth into a common near zone of access.

changed_reading.before: Two gardens are a numerical doubling of scenery.
changed_reading.after: They are a coupled productive system whose distinct growth converges as one accessible yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: Womb, pregnancy-gathering, delivery, and fruit-sheath cues activate a dormant focus cluster: labor posture, belly/interior, fetus under cover, and nearness to birth. The botanical yield can consequently be carried as abundance at the threshold of emergence, not only abundance already set on display.

activation_trace.role: Introduces the womb as an enclosing site that protects and forms what will emerge.
Adds the form-distant image of a womb gathering and retaining a pregnancy.
Turns laying down into a possible transition from carried enclosure to delivered presence.
Gives the plant analogue of fruit held inside its sheath before exposure.
Activates the rare bodily image of a laboring animal's strained posture beneath ordinary reclining.
Supplies the belly or interior chamber in which something can be carried unseen.
Makes concealment specifically gestational through the fetus hidden in the belly.
Marks the carried content as nearing delivery, converting static closeness into temporal imminence.

structural_cues: Packet order moves from womb and pregnancy-gathering through laying down and plant sheaths before the focus clusters interior, concealed offspring, labor posture, and near delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies womb, gestation, delivery, sheath, labor-posture, and near-birth images; I supply the arrow that aligns them as poised emergence. A live alternative is ordinary botanical containment plus bodily repose with no birth analogy.

changed_reading.before: Everything valuable is already finished, exposed, and available.
changed_reading.after: The scene also holds a birth-like threshold: protected abundance has matured inside coverings and is now near release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two-seas episode supplies approaching or mixed expanses, an interval, blocked transgression, and precious matter brought out of concealment. This revises the focus's hidden lining from a sealed secret into a regulated membrane: the source remains covered while its value crosses into reach.

activation_trace.role: Supplies unstable mixture as the pressure against which a boundary must keep domains distinct.
Places an operative interval between two sides rather than treating separation as empty distance.
Defines boundary failure as wrongful overstepping, so preserved distinction becomes functional restraint.
Provides the directed passage by which a concealed value is made manifest.
Identifies the emergent object as precious rather than as leakage or waste.
Gives the focus a protected inner layer capable of mediating inside and outside.
Supplies the transferable value that can leave a protected source without destroying it.

structural_cues: Verses 55:19-22 sequence contact, an intervening limit, non-transgression, and emergence; 55:54 likewise joins concealed construction to accessible yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mixture, interval, restraint, extraction, pearl, lining, and produce; I infer that the boundary enables selective delivery rather than merely blocking contact. Alternatively, the sea episode and the furnishings may remain independent examples of abundance.

changed_reading.before: Hidden luxury is valuable because it stays sealed from view.
changed_reading.after: Hidden luxury behaves like a governed membrane: concealment preserves the source while allowing its yield to emerge safely.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between universal disappearance and remaining recasts reclining as transferred reliance. The beds are not autonomous guarantees of permanence; they stage a supported nearness available after ordinary supports and possessions have failed.

activation_trace.role: Removes the assumption that any created surface or possession carries permanence in itself.
Supplies enduring continuance as the counterpole to disappearing created supports.
Keeps the focus anchored in dependence: the recliner is held by something beyond the self.
Makes the resulting security relationally near rather than an abstract claim about durable objects.

structural_cues: The paired antithesis of 55:26-27 precedes the judgment-and-garden movement, while 55:54 foregrounds reliance and nearness rather than ownership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disappearance, continuance, reliance, and nearness; I infer a transfer from failed created supports to granted support. Alternatively, the antithesis may frame the surah globally without specifying the furniture's function.

changed_reading.before: The furnishings promise security because they are intrinsically durable luxuries.
changed_reading.after: Their security is derivative: repose depicts dependence stabilized by an enduring giver, not permanence possessed by the objects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky's splitting and conversion into a rose-colored, oil-like surface trains attention on skins that open and change state. Against that cue, the focus's decision to name only a furnishing's inner layer becomes an epistemic reversal: an underside normally hidden is disclosed as evidence.

activation_trace.role: Opens a formerly continuous surface and makes its hidden-sided structure perceptible.
Marks the opened sky through a flower-like red color, turning surface appearance into an event.
Adds the material behavior of an oil or coating to the transformed visible skin.
Provides a layered material body whose faces can differ.
Selects the normally concealed face of that layered body for explicit disclosure.

structural_cues: A cosmic surface opens and changes material appearance in 55:37; 55:54 later privileges an object's underside over its unmentioned exterior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rupture, colored coating, material layering, and lining; I infer that the earlier surface event licenses an inside-out disclosure pattern. Alternatively, the sky simile and silk lining are unrelated visual details.

changed_reading.before: Naming the lining is merely an indirect superlative about expensive upholstery.
changed_reading.after: Naming the lining participates in a wider surface reversal: what should be underneath is exposed so hidden order becomes legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The movement from offense, recognition, and seizure to deed-for-deed recompense activates the liability branch of the focus's yield word. Botanical harvest and accrued consequence can coexist: the near fruit becomes a good return made tangible and ready to receive, not arbitrary decor.

activation_trace.role: Introduces moral liability as something attributable before the garden sequence.
Joins crime and offense to an acquisition-like root field, preparing an accrued-result model.
Makes liability operative by connecting wrongdoing with being taken to account.
Supplies the explicit rule that an act is met by its corresponding return.
Specifies beneficent action on both sides of the return, giving the garden harvest a positive ethical valence.
Opens the lexical pivot from picked produce to an act whose consequence is drawn upon its agent or group.
Keeps the activated consequence visibly anchored as actual garden produce rather than dissolving it into abstraction.

structural_cues: Recognition and taking occur in 55:39-41, the focus renders yield near in 55:54, and 55:60 states matching return after the garden details.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies offense, accountability, matching return, good action, and the yield/liability polysemy; I infer that fruit materializes accrued good. Alternatively, the focus may use only the botanical branch and leave recompense to 55:60.

changed_reading.before: The near fruit is an unmotivated luxury added to the reward scene.
changed_reading.after: It is also an embodied return: what has been accrued comes near as a harvest that can be received.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two gardens are assigned to one who feared the Lord's station; the focus then changes bodily register from anticipated danger and upright standing to supported reclining. Repose is the resolved form of vigilance, not generic idleness.

activation_trace.role: Activates bodily uprightness beneath the station language, furnishing the posture that reclining reverses.
Supplies anticipatory vigilance as the affective load carried into the garden scene.
Releases that load through a body permitted to lean fully on support.
Provides the prepared surface on which the posture can change from standing to rest.

structural_cues: Verse 55:46 governs the first garden pair with fear and station; verse 55:54 culminates the same pair in a plural reclining posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear, station/uprightness, and supported reclining; I infer a temporal and bodily reversal from vigilance to repose. Alternatively, maqam may denote only standing before the Lord and need not describe the beneficiary's prior posture.

changed_reading.before: Reclining signifies effortless leisure without a history.
changed_reading.after: Reclining is vigilance completed: a morally alert standing posture is transformed into licensed, supported rest.

context_deltas.mechanism: Branching canopies, paired springs in motion, and paired fruits make the garden a distributed production network. The focus's near yield is its terminal interface: growth and water do the traveling work that lets the recliner remain still.

activation_trace.role: Supplies branching, extended limbs as the garden's distributed productive structure.
Locates replenishment in flowing water sources within each garden.
Adds directed movement through the system rather than a static pool of resources.
Names the pleasant edible output produced by the watered branching system.
Organizes output in joined pairs, matching the paired gardens and paired springs.
Converts living output into produce available to be gathered at the endpoint.
Places that endpoint at the resting body's immediate edge.

structural_cues: Within 55:48-54, branches precede flowing paired springs, paired fruit kinds, and finally gathered yield at the recliner.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branching, springs, flow, paired fruit, gathered yield, and nearness; I infer a replenishing delivery chain from water to growth to recipient. Alternatively, these may be adjacent amenities with no asserted causal plumbing.

changed_reading.before: Fruit has simply been placed beside the couches.
changed_reading.after: Near fruit is the endpoint of a self-renewing ecology whose distributed movement serves a motionless recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later phrase introducing another two gardens with a distinct but resonant root for nearness-below activates the nearer/lower branch of the focus's final adjective. Nearness can therefore be scalar and tiered as well as horizontal: paired gardens occupy relations of rank or level while still bringing yield close.

activation_trace.role: Introduces proximity that falls short of an endpoint, carrying a possible below-or-nearer relation.
Repeats the tree-covered dual enclosure so the scalar cue attaches to the same garden architecture.
Adds the focus root's own nearer, lower, or first-side branch, allowing a vertical or ranked echo.
Keeps the cross-root echo attached to the focus's first pair of actual gardens.

structural_cues: The focus ends its first garden pair with danin; 55:62 introduces a second garden pair with min dunihima, pairing similar sounds and scalar branch images across distinct roots.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two distinct near/below root fields beside repeated dual gardens; I infer a deliberately resonant scalar architecture. Alternatively, dun may simply mean 'besides' and danin only arm's-reach proximity, with no hierarchy.

changed_reading.before: Nearness is only the short horizontal distance from hand to fruit.
changed_reading.after: Nearness also participates in a layered garden topology, where access, level, and rank can coexist without collapsing the two pairs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact return of reclining-on syntax near the end of the second garden pair establishes supported repose as an invariant endpoint, while drooping green covers and rare patterned carpets vary the material implementation. The focus's silk-lined beds are one tier-specific realization of a repeated outcome rather than an isolated still life.

activation_trace.role: Repeats the same reliance posture and confirms support as the invariant bodily outcome.
Substitutes a hanging or sheltering textile edge for the focus's explicitly named inner lining.
Makes flourishing ease and pleasant life part of the second support surface's register.
Supplies the second scene's precious patterned carpets, preserving luxury while changing material vocabulary.
Closes the varied materials under a shared judgment of beauty.
Anchors the first occurrence of the posture against which the later recurrence is read.
Preserves the first tier's distinctive emphasis on concealed textile construction.

structural_cues: Verses 55:54 and 55:76 open with the same plural reclining construction and preposition, each near the close of a two-garden catalogue, but name different support materials.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact posture recurrence and contrasting textiles; I infer an invariant endpoint with tier-specific implementations. Alternatively, the repetition may be rhetorical parallelism without encoding rank or functional equivalence.

changed_reading.before: Verse 55:54 is a self-contained luxury vignette.
changed_reading.after: It is the first realization of a repeated garden endpoint: supported repose persists while each pair exposes a different layer of abundance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates container-fastening and fullness branches beneath the ordinary reclining form. It remains anchored in the focus's interior, covering, and near yield, and gains context support from vessel-emptying and flowing springs. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for stored-and-released abundance, not as a replacement translation of the reclining word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reclining root's vessel branches combine with lining, concealment, and accessible yield.

activation_trace.role: Reimagines support as the tie that seals a container and controls its contents.
Adds a state of retained fullness, making the scene materially stocked rather than merely padded.
Supplies the containing cavity or inward face in which fullness can be held.
Keeps the stored content protected from perception until release.
Provides the complementary action of pouring out and emptying a vessel.
Introduces an internal source from which the garden's fluid provision issues.
Carries released contents through the garden toward their accessible endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The couches and gardens are separate objects in a room-like scene.
changed_reading.after: They can also form one vessel-like hydraulic system: abundance is enclosed, filled, and selectively released toward the recliners.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the lining word's confidant branch color a literal textile. It remains anchored in plural recliners, inwardness, concealed garden space, and near relation, with later confinement and tents reinforcing protected access. Downstream prose should call it a social resonance of intimacy and admission, not claim that the linings syntactically denote people.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Plural reclining around batana, concealed gardens, and nearness permits a social interior alongside the material one.

activation_trace.role: Locates a plural company in a shared posture of unguarded reliance.
Activates the social image of confidants admitted to a person's inward affairs.
Provides an actual place of concealment in which an admitted company can be protected.
Allows spatial proximity to carry relational or kin-like closeness as well.
Reinforces selective intimacy through being held within a bounded sphere.
Adds the tent as a protected dwelling that admits insiders while screening the public exterior.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes private ownership of expensive objects.
changed_reading.after: It may also stage admission into a protected inner company, where material lining doubles as a social grammar of trusted proximity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it borrows a rare bodily-bending branch from the adjective that syntactically describes the yield. It remains anchored in leaning bodies, spread limbs, vigorous growth, branching, and a later drooping cover. Downstream prose should render a visual posture echo between recliner and laden garden, not reassign the adjective's grammar from fruit to person.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The recliner leans over a spread surface while vigorous garden growth and its yield draw near.

activation_trace.role: Gives the human side of the image a supported inclination rather than a rigid upright line.
Spreads body or limbs over a place, extending the recliner horizontally toward the garden edge.
Supplies the rare shape of an upper part bending toward the middle, usable as a visual echo of nearness.
Makes the garden side thick, vigorous, and capable of extending toward the recliner.
Adds long branching limbs that can project or bend across the intervening space.
Confirms a later garden vocabulary of hanging or drooping edges around the repeated reclining posture.

changed_reading.before: Nearness is a neutral measurement between stationary fruit and person.
changed_reading.after: Nearness can be pictured as reciprocal inclination: the supported body leans outward while laden growth bends inward to meet it.

strongest_changes: Hidden lining changed from conspicuous luxury into a regulated inside-to-outside delivery structure.
Reclining changed from idle leisure into the bodily resolution of vigilance and the endpoint of an ecological service network.
Garden yield changed from decorative fruit into both gathered produce and a tangible return accrued through action.
Nearness changed from one short distance into temporal imminence, relational dependence, and a possible scalar garden topology.
The later reclining recurrence changed 55:54 from an isolated vignette into one implementation of a repeated two-garden endpoint.
summary.what_was_special: A compact luxury scene held unusually dense cross-domain switches: support could become labor or a vessel seal; lining could become hidden reality or an inner circle; yield could become liability; garden concealment could become gestation; and nearness could become delivery, rank, or reciprocal posture. Context did not select one winner but activated several inspectable mechanisms that remain anchored in the focus.
remaining_uncertainties: The gestational chain is unusually coherent but depends on several rare or form-distant branches, so it should remain an emergence analogy.
The accrued-harvest reading competes directly with the focus word's much stronger botanical branch.
The danin/dunihima resonance crosses distinct roots and does not by itself decide whether the second garden pair is lower, nearer, or simply additional.
The causal flow from springs through branches to near fruit is reader-supplied; the packet also permits a noncausal catalogue of amenities.
The inside-out surface model does not determine the unmentioned outer material of the beds.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Rest supported by spread and hidden interior.** `ف ر ش/B001,B002` gives prepared spreading and bedding; `ب ط ن/B001` gives the inner side. The posture, furnishing, and specified lining create layered support. I infer that visible rest depends on an unseen interior quality. The ayah reads as provision from inside out.
2. **Produce brought near rather than seized.** `ج ن ي/B001` gives gathered produce and `د ن و/B001` gives nearness. The prior branches and flowing springs supply the production system; I infer that mature yield is delivered into reach. The ayah reverses 55:33: access is granted by proximity, not achieved by forced penetration.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:76 repeats reclining with green rafraf and rich patterned furnishings. The later scene preserves supported rest but changes its material vocabulary, preventing the two garden pairs from merging.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **`و ك ء` `B004` — “recline on support,” `ف ر ش` `B002` — “bedding,” `ب ط ن` `B003` — “lining,” `ج ن ي` `B001` — “gathered produce,” and `د ن و` `B001` — “near.”** Structural cue: supported posture is paired with a statement about the furnishings’ hidden underside, then coordinated with nearness of both gardens’ harvest. Assigned role: support removes bodily effort, fine lining marks quality in a concealed layer, and nearness removes the distance to provision. Packet evidence is the posture-material-access sequence. Inference: repose is produced by reducing both exertion and access cost while sustaining quality beyond the immediately visible surface. Reading change: the ayah specifies an ergonomics of abundance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:56 added an unexpected relational analogue to reduced access cost: repose includes not only near produce but also removal of competing prior claims.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P4 Layered Repose and Guarded Intimacy
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Comfort and intimacy are made possible by layered interiors, bodily support, controlled sight, and a maintained boundary against prior contact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Textile lining, confidants, shields, tied openings, and graspable boundaries make privacy a constructed mechanism rather than an abstract condition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Supported Body inside a Layered Interior
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A reclining body is supported by spread furnishings whose hidden lining creates an interior within the garden enclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: reclining on a support `quranic:root_001678:B004/m01`; spreading and preparing a surface `quranic:root_001143:B001/m01`; bed and household furnishing `quranic:root_001143:B002/m01`; thin plates and layers `quranic:root_001143:B010/m01`; interior or underside `quranic:root_000128:B001/m01`; hidden interior `quranic:root_000128:B002/m01`; garment lining `quranic:root_000128:B003/m01`; intimate inner circle `quranic:root_000128:B004/m01`; concealment `quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`; protective cover `quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`; tying a vessel closed `quranic:root_001678:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The furnishing is a nested structure: spread surface, internal lining, and supported body. Lexical extensions from lining to confidant and from covering to shield make the physical interior simultaneously a social zone of protected nearness.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P4 Recompense as Return and Yield
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An action produces a corresponding return in the same way that a cultivated source yields fruit for gathering.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Harvest vocabulary carries an embedded legal reversal: *jany* can name both gathering fruit and incurring an offense, so beneficial and harmful deeds each generate their own yield.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Near Harvest and Acquired Yield
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Ripe produce remains close enough to be selected and gathered directly from its source.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gathering produce from its source `quranic:root_000267:B001/m01`; incurring an offense `quranic:root_000267:B002/m01`; false accusation `quranic:root_000267:B003/m01`; giving a companion the best gathered portion `quranic:root_000267:B004/m01`; edible fruit `quranic:root_001174:B002/m01`; physical nearness `quranic:root_000493:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Nearness removes the interval between source, choice, and possession. Yet the same gathering-root can describe drawing culpability onto oneself or another, making harvest a neutral mechanism whose moral quality depends on what action has been cultivated.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir seyi baglayan bag ile ozellikle tulum ya da kap agzini ip veya kayisla sikica baglama eylemini birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin hem bag aracini hem de o aracla yapilan kapatma eylemini kapsayan cercevesi kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, genel olarak her turlu baglama degil, bir bagi ve ozellikle tulum ya da kap agzinin o bagla sikilmasini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanim, bag adini dalin yalniz kullanilan yonu olarak korur; tulum ya da kabi baglama eylemini ise taniklanan yapilara bagli ayri bir yon olarak gosterir.

concept_map.definition: Iki yer arasindaki mesafeyi yogun bir cabayla ve siddetli yuruyusle butunuyle katetmektir. Buna bagli olarak kisi, yuruyusunu sertlestiren ve kendini zorlayan biri diye nitelenir.

facets.statement: Yuruyus, hiz ve guc artirilarak siddetli bicimde yapilir.
Taniklanan yapida iki yer arasindaki mesafe bu yogun yuruyusle butunuyle kat edilir.
Yuruyusunu siddetlendiren ve kendini zorlayan kisi bu hareket ozelligiyle nitelenir.
Mesafeyi doldurma, dolu bir kabin ardindan agzinin baglanmasina benzetilen aciklayici bir tasarimla da verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, iki yer arasini yogun bir hareketle tamamlamayi ve yuruyusu sertlestirip hizlandirmayi ayni anlam alaninda birlestirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Mesafenin tamamlanmasini ve yuruyusun yogunlugunu birlikte koruyan genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Iki yer arasini tamamlama, siddetli yuruyus ve yogun caba bilesenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Iki yer arasindaki mesafenin yogun hareketle tamamlanmasi anlatilirken kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Mesafeyi hizli bicimde butunuyle gecme yonunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Yuruyusun sertligi ve kendini zorlama yonunu acikca belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kisinin yuruyusunu siddetlendiren biri olarak nitelendirilmesinde kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kisinin yuruyuste kendini zorlamasi ve adimlarini sertlestirmesi yonunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Iki yer arasindaki mesafeyi butunuyle katetme kosulunu kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iki yer arasini siddetli yuruyusle butunuyle katetmek

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir seye yaslanmayi, degnege dayanarak guc almayi, yaslanilacak destek hazirlamayi ve birini yaslanir duruma getirmeyi birlikte taniklar. Dal cercevesi, bedenin dayanakla iliskisini ve bundan tureyen destek nesnesi ile ettirgen eylemleri dogru bicimde bir arada tutar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Merkez, bedenin bir seye dayanip yaslanmasidir; destek nesnesi hazirlama ve birini yaslandirma bu merkeze bagli yonlerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanim, yaslanma ve destek adlarini korur; belirli bir seye yaslanma, destek hazirlama ve birini yaslandirma eylemlerini kendi yapisal sinirlari icinde ayirir.

concept_map.definition: Bedeni bir nesneye, ozellikle bir degnege vererek dayanmak ve ondan destek almaktir. Buna bagli olarak yaslanilan yer ya da nesne, boyle bir destek hazirlama ve birini destek uzerine yaslanir duruma getirme de anlatilir.

facets.statement: Kisi bedenini bir nesneye vererek ona dayanir ve ondan destek alir.
Degnege yaslanmada kisi agirligini degnege vererek guc ve denge kazanir.
Yaslanilan yer ya da nesne, bedenin dayanmasini saglayan destek olarak adlandirilir.
Bir kisi icin yaslanacagi destek hazirlamak bu anlam merkezine bagli ettirgen bir eylemdir.
Birini destek uzerine koyup yaslanir duruma getirmek ya da yaslanan kisi durusuna sokmak da anlatilir.
Destek nesnesinin bulundugu yer, oturulan mekan anlamina genisleyebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bedeni bir seye dayayip destek alma cekirdeginde birlesir; destek nesnesi, destek hazirlama ve birini yaslandirma bu cekirdegin ad ve ettirgen uzantilaridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalin bedenle dayanak arasindaki temel iliskiyi, destek nesnesini ve ettirgen uzantilarini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Yaslanma, destek alma, dayanak hazirlama ve birini yaslanir duruma getirme yonlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kisinin bir nesneye, ozellikle degnege agirligini vererek dayanmasi anlatilirken kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Bedeni bir nesneye dayama ve ondan destek alma cekirdegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Destek nesnesi, destek hazirlama ve baskasini yaslandirma yonlerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bedenin dayandigi nesne ya da yer adlandirilirken kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Yaslanmayi saglayan destek nesnesi ya da yer yonunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Yaslanma eylemini ve ettirgen kullanimlari kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kisiyi destek uzerine yerlestirme ya da yaslanan kisi durusuna sokma baglaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.loses: Kisinin kendi yaslanmasini ve destek nesnesinin ad olarak kullanimini kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kiside cinsel birlesmeye yonelik siddetli bir gereksinim bulunmasini belirli bir niteleme yapisi icinde verir. Dal cercevesi bu yogun cinsel ihtiyaci dogru yakalar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanim yalniz taniklanan niteleme yapisina baglidir; buradan kokun yalniz kullanimina ait genel bir cinsel istek anlami cikarilmaz.

Bu anlam, kisiyi yogun cinsel ihtiyaciyla niteleyen belirli bir soz yapisiyla sinirlidir.

Tulum ya da benzeri bir kap icerikle dolar.
Insan karninda atik disariya cikamaz ve bosaltim tutulur.
Kalın derili tulum agziyla ilgili olumsuz kullanim taniklansa da pratik anlam siniri kaynakta acik degildir.

source_note.TA: Tek taniklik, develerin yagla ve tulumun icerikle dolmasini; insan karninda ise atigin cikmayip tutulmasini bildirir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kokun dallari somut bir bagi ve kapatmayi; vermeyi esirgemeyi ya da agzini tutup susmayi; siddetli yuruyusu; dayanip yaslanmayi; yogun cinsel ihtiyaci; devenin dogum sancisindaki kivranisini; doluluk ve bosaltimin tutulmasini anlatir. Anlamlar kismen sikma, destek ve iceride tutma tasarimlariyla baglansa da birkac bagimsiz alana dagilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi yayarak düzleme ve kullanıma elverişli duruma getirme çekirdeğini açıkça taşır. Geniş alan, basık tepe, evin zeminini döşeme ve genişlik bildiren türev bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, yayma ve hazırlama eylemidir; serilmiş eşyanın kendisini, aile hukukundaki kullanımı ya da hayvan ve böcek adlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yayma ve düzleme çekirdeğini korur; bir işi bütünüyle anlatma, yeri yaşanır kılma ve ev zeminini döşeme anlamları yalnız kendi söz öbeklerine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi açıp yayarak yüzeyini düzlemek, yerleşmeye ya da kullanıma elverişli biçimde hazırlamaktır. Bu çekirdek bazı yapılarda bir konuyu bütünüyle açıklamaya, bir zemini döşemeye ve düz ya da geniş bir yüzeyi nitelemeye uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi ya da örtüyü açıp yaymak ve yüzeyini düzleyerek hazırlamak.
Bir yeri üzerinde durmaya elverişli kılmak veya evin zeminini taş ya da benzeri malzemeyle döşemek.
Bir konuyu karşıdakine bütünüyle açıp ayrıntısıyla sunmak.
Düzleşmiş tepeyi, geniş açık alanı veya genişlik bildiren türevi adlandırmak.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yayma, düzleme ve hazırlama çekirdeğinde birleşir; zemin döşeme, bütünüyle anlatma, geniş alan ve basık tepe kullanımları bu çekirdeğin özel uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Nesne, örtü veya zemin üzerinde gerçekleşen temel eylemi ve ona doğrudan bağlı hazırlama sonucunu birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yayma, düzleme ve kullanıma hazırlama işlemlerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir örtünün, kumaşın veya benzeri bir nesnenin açılıp düzlenmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Somut nesneyi açma, yayma ve düzleme hareketini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir evin veya yerin tabanını taş ya da başka bir malzemeyle kaplama yapısında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Zemini kaplayıp kullanıma hazırlayan özel işlemi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işi veya konuyu karşıdakine genişçe ve eksiksiz biçimde sunan söz öbeğine özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Bilgiyi genişçe ortaya koyma ve bütünüyle açıklama uzantısını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yaymanın yanında yüzeyi düzleme ve bir şeyi kullanıma hazırlama sonucu belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel uzatma ve genişletme, bir şeyi hazırlama sonucu olmadan da kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin kapladığı alanı açma, yayma ve genişletme hareketini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda yayma, yüzeyi düzleyip elverişli duruma getiren bir işlemdir; komşu dal ise hazırlama sonucunu şart koşmadan genel yayılma ve uzamayı kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyi serme, düzleme ve hazırlama eylemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Serilmiş eşyanın, yatağın veya hazırlanmış yerin kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir yüzeyin serilerek kullanıma hazırlanması sahnesine bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal işlemi, komşu dal ise bu işlemin ürünü olan serili eşya ya da hazırlanmış yeri kavramlaştırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; eylem çekirdeğini sonuçtan ve genel yayılmadan ayıran iki karşılaştırma seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بسط الشيء أو الثوب أو الفراش، والتمهيد، وفرش الأمر كله، وتفريش الدار بتبليطها، والفضاء الواسع، والأكمة الدكاء، والواسع المزيد فيه نحو الفرشاط
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الفراش الزوجي من جهة النسب، ولا صغار الأنعام، ولا الفراش الطائر
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل صحيح يدل على تمهيد الشيء وبسطه؛ فرشت الفراش أفرشه (maqayis)؛ فرشت الفراش بسطته؛ فرشته أمري بسطته كله له (ayn)؛ فرشت الشيء بسطته؛ الفرش الفضاء الواسع؛ أكمة مفترشة الظهر إذا كانت دكاء (sihah)؛ فرشت زيدا بساطا؛ فرش فلان داره إذا بلطها؛ فرشته أمري أي بسطته كله (tahdhib)؛ الفرش بسط الثياب؛ جعل لكم الأرض فراشا أي ذللها (mufradat)؛ الفرشاط الواسع مما زيدت فيه الطاء والأصل فرش (maqayis_variant)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi serilmiş ev eşyasını, üzerinde yatılan veya oturulan örtüyü ve hazırlanmış yer sayılan ev ya da kuş yuvasını aynı sonuç odaklı anlamda toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal serme eylemini değil, serilmiş nesneyi veya hazırlanmış yeri adlandırır; evlilik, hayvan ve böcek anlamları dışarıdadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın adlandırmanın serili eşya ve hazırlanmış yer kapsamıyla sınırlıdır; başka dallardaki eylem ve mecazlar içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Üzerinde yatmak, oturmak veya bir yeri donatmak için serilmiş eşya ya da örtüdür. Hazırlanmış barınak niteliği öne çıktığında ev veya kuş yuvası da bu adla anılır.

facets.statement: Yatmak, oturmak veya evi donatmak için yere ya da bir taşıta serilen eşya.
İçinde barınılan ve önceden hazırlanmış yer olarak ev veya kuş yuvası.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar serilmiş ev eşyası ve üzerinde yatılan ya da oturulan örtü anlamını ortaklaşa verir; hazırlanmış yer benzerliğiyle ev ve kuş yuvası da kapsama girer.

concept_gloss.applicability: Serilmiş ev eşyasını ve üzerinde yatılan ya da oturulan temel nesneyi doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Serilmiş eşya, yatma yüzeyi ve döşek niteliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üzerinde yatılan veya oturulan serili eşyanın tekil ve doğal karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Serilmiş ve bedenin altında kullanılan eşya anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ev veya kuş yuvasının serilmiş ve oturmaya hazırlanmış yer sayıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Barınma için hazırlanmış yer uzantısını açık biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Serili ev eşyasının yanında ev ve kuş yuvası gibi hazırlanmış yerleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Örnek ya da desen adı olarak kullanılabilen daha özel bir adlandırma alanı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de yere serilen, üzerinde yatılan ya da oturulan eşyayı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal serili eşya çekirdeğinde çok yakındır, ancak odak dalın hazırlanmış barınak uzantısını bütünüyle paylaşmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Serme işlemi tamamlandıktan sonra ortaya çıkan eşya veya hazırlanmış yeri adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nesneyi yayma, yüzeyi düzleme ve hazırlama eylemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı serme ve yer hazırlama sahnesinin farklı aşamalarını kavramlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sonuçtaki nesneye, komşu dal ise bu sonucu doğuran işleme yönelir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Özellikle serilmiş ve bedenin altında kullanılan eşyayı merkeze alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ev eşyası, mal ve servet dahil çok daha geniş bir taşınır eşya alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal evde kullanılan sergi ve döşekleri içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal serilmiş kullanım yüzeyiyle sınırlıyken komşu dal döşekleri daha geniş ev eşyası ve mal varlığı içinde ele alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; serili eşya, serme eylemi ve genel ev eşyası arasındaki sınırları gösteren üç aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الفراش والمفروش وفرش البيت وما ينام عليه، والمفرش والمفرشة على الرحل، والبيت أو عش الطائر من جهة كونه موضعا مفروشا أو مهيأ
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس فعل البسط نفسه، ولا الزوج أو المرأة في حكم الفراش، ولا الفراش الطائر
branches.source_phrase_ar: الفرش المفروش أيضا (maqayis)؛ المفرش شيء يكون مثل شاذكونه؛ المفرشة على الرحل (ayn)؛ الفراش واحد الفرش؛ الفرش المفروش من متاع البيت (sihah)؛ الفراش ما ينامان عليه؛ الفراش البيت؛ الفراش عش الطائر؛ المفرشة تكون على الرحل (tahdhib)؛ يقال للمفروش فرش وفراش؛ وفرش مرفوعة؛ فرش بطائنها من إستبرق (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yatak imgesini evlilik bağına taşıyarak kadını, kocayı veya yatağın sahibini anlatır; çocuk nesebinin bu bağa verilmesi ve evlenme ya da cinsel birliktelik anlatımları aynı hukuki-toplumsal çerçevededir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam evlilik ve nesep ilişkisine bağlı mecazdır; gerçek döşek, hayvan yavrusu ve uçan böcek anlamları dışarıdadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım evlilik bağına yönelik yalın mecazı korur; çocuğun nesebe bağlanması, soylu kadınla evlenme ve birliktelik anlamları yalnız ilgili yapılarda geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Evlilik yatağı üzerinden eşlerden birini veya evlilik birliğinin sahibini anlatan bir mecazdır. Bu mecaz, çocuğun nesebini evlilik bağına verme, soylu bir kadınla evlenme ve bir kadınla cinsel birliktelik kurma ifadelerinde özelleşir.

facets.statement: Evlilik yatağı aracılığıyla kadını, kocayı veya evlilik birliğinin sahibini anlatmak.
Çocuğun nesebini evlilik birliğinin sahibine bağlamak.
Soylu kadınlarla evlenmeyi veya bir kadınla cinsel birliktelik kurmayı anlatmak.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yatak sözünün eşler ve evlilik bağı için mecazlaşmasında birleşir; nesep hükmü, soylu kadınla evlenme ve cinsel birliktelik bu çerçevenin özel kullanımlarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eşleri, evlilik birliğini ve nesep bağını yatak imgesi üzerinden birlikte açıklayan üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Evlilik, eşlik ve nesebin dayandığı birlik anlamlarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çocuğun kime nispet edileceğini belirleyen hukuki veya soyla ilgili bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Evlilik bağına dayalı nesep sahibini açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir erkeğin soylu veya saygın kadınlarla evlenmiş olduğunu bildiren kalıpta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Evliliğin eşlerin saygınlığı üzerinden nitelenmesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Eşlik, evlilik birliğinin sahipliği ve çocuğun nesebe bağlanması boyutlarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Doğrudan cinsel birleşme eylemini adlandırır ve evlilik ya da nesep bağını zorunlu kılmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal eşler arasındaki cinsel ilişki sahnesine girebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yatağı evlilik ve nesep için mecazlaştırır; komşu dal ise ilişkinin kendisini, hukuki bağın sahipliğini anlatmadan adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çocuğun evlilik birliğine bağlanması ve yatağın sahibi kavramı belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Evlenme ve cinsel yeterlik alanını nesep hükmü olmadan daha genel biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da barınma veya yatak imgesini evlilik ve cinsel birliktelik için mecazlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı yanı evlilik yatağının eş ve nesep sahibi sayılmasıdır; komşu dalda bu hukuki ilişki zorunlu değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yatağı eş, evlilik ve nesep bağı için mecaz olarak kullanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gerçek serili eşya veya hazırlanmış barınak anlamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: mecazi evlilik yatağı ile gerçek döşek
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı yatak imgesinden ve ev içi kullanım sahnesinden yararlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal toplumsal ve hukuki ilişkiyi, komşu dal ise somut eşyayı anlatır; aralarındaki bağ tematik ve mecazidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; evlilik, nesep, cinsel birleşme ve gerçek döşek arasındaki en yararlı üç ayrım seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كناية الفراش عن المرأة أو الزوج أو مالك الفراش، وقول الولد للفراش، وكريم المفارش بمعنى تزوج كرائم النساء، والجارية الفريش التي افترشها الرجل
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس متاع النوم ولا صغار الأنعام ولا الفراش الطائر
branches.source_phrase_ar: الولد للفراش؛ أراد به الزوج؛ الفراش في الحقيقة المرأة؛ كريم المفارش إذا تزوج كريم النساء (maqayis)؛ جارية فريش افترشها الرجل (ayn)؛ الفراش يكنى به عن المرأة؛ كريم المفارش إذا تزوج كرائم النساء؛ افترشه أي وطئه (sihah)؛ الفراش الزوج؛ الفراش المرأة؛ الولد للفراش معناه لمالك الفراش؛ جارية فريش قد افترشها الرجل؛ افترش كريمة بني فلان إذا تزوجها (tahdhib)؛ كني بالفراش عن كل واحد من الزوجين؛ الولد للفراش؛ كريم المفارش أي النساء (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın çizgisi küçük, yük taşımayan veya kesimlik evcil hayvanlardır. Bununla birlikte bir yorum sözü binilen hayvanla ilişkilendirir; bu nedenle tanım çoğunluk çekirdeğini korurken kaynak içi kapsam farkını açıkça sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, küçük ya da yük hayvanı sayılmayan evcil hayvan sınıfıdır; tek bir yorumdaki binilme açıklaması bütün dalın zorunlu ölçütü değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın hayvan sınıfını verir ve onu küçük, yük taşımayan veya kesimlik olma ölçütleriyle sınırlar; başka dallardaki serme anlamı aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Küçük olan, yük taşımaya elverişli sayılmayan veya daha çok kesim ve yemek için ayrılan evcil hayvanlar sınıfıdır. Özellikle deve yavruları öne çıkar; koyun ve sığırın da bu sınıfa katıldığı, buna karşılık bir yorumda binilen hayvan bağlantısı kurulduğu belirtilir.

facets.statement: Küçük, yük taşımaya elverişli olmayan ya da kesimlik sayılan evcil hayvanlar.
Özellikle küçük develer ile bu sınıfa katılan koyun ve sığırlar.
Bir yorumda sınıfın, yere yakın olduğu için binilen hayvanlarla ilişkilendirilmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt küçük develer ile yük taşımayan veya kesimlik hayvanları merkeze alır ve koyunla sığırı da kapsama katabilir; bir yorum ise sınıfı binilme özelliğiyle açıklar.

concept_gloss.text: küçük veya yük taşımayan evcil hayvan
concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvanları yaş, yük taşıma elverişliliği ve kesim amacı bakımından ayıran sınıfı karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Küçüklük, yük taşımama ve kesimlik olma ölçütlerinin alternatifli yapısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deve yavrularının merkezde olduğu ve koyunla sığırın da sınıfa katıldığı açıklayıcı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Küçük deve odağını ve diğer evcil hayvanlara açılan kapsamı korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: küçük, yük taşımayan veya kesimlik evcil hayvanlar

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yaştan başka yük taşımaya elverişsizlik ve kesimlik olma ölçütlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Belirli yavru hayvan adlarını ve özellikle deve yavrusunun gelişim basamaklarını öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal küçük develeri ve başka küçük evcil hayvanları adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yavruluk ve özel hayvan adlarına yoğunlaşırken odak dal işlevsel olarak yük taşımayan veya kesimlik hayvanları da sınıfa katar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hayvanları küçüklük veya yük taşıma niteliğine göre sınıflandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaş ve işlev ayrımı yapmadan bir hayvan topluluğunu ya da sürüyü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal koyun, sığır veya başka evcil hayvan topluluklarıyla ilgili olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hayvanların niteliğini belirleyen bir sınıf, komşu dal ise birlikte bulunan hayvanların oluşturduğu topluluktur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; küçük hayvan sınıfını özel yavru adlarından ve sürü kavramından ayıran iki karşılaştırma seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الفرش من الأنعام، وصغار الإبل، وما دون الحمولة أو ما لا يصلح إلا للذبح، والغنم والبقر الداخلة في الفرش عند بعض أهل اللغة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الفراش الذي ينام عليه، ولا الفراش الطائر، ولا فرش الحطب
branches.source_phrase_ar: الفرش من الأنعام الذي لا يصلح إلا للذبح والأكل (maqayis)؛ الفرش من النعم التي لا تصلح إلا للذبح وهي ما دون الحمولة؛ ومن الأنعام حمولة وفرشا (ayn)؛ الفرش صغار الإبل؛ حمولة وفرشا؛ يحتمل أن يكون مصدرا من فرشها الله أي بثها بثا (sihah)؛ الفرش الصغار؛ أجمع أهل اللغة على أن الفرش صغار الإبل وأن الغنم والبقر من الفرش (tahdhib)؛ الفرش ما يفرش من الأنعام أي يركب؛ حمولة وفرشا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ışığa veya ateşe yönelip çevresinde çırpınan küçük uçan böceği merkeze alır ve hafif, telaşlı insan benzetmesini aynı özellikten türetir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal uçan böceği ve hafif insan benzetmesini kapsar; döşek, baş kemiği parçaları ve kilit levhası anlamları dışarıdadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın böcek adını ve ondan doğrudan kurulan hafif insan benzetmesini içerir; başka ince nesne adları bu dala taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Işığa veya ateşe yönelip çevresinde çırpınan küçük, hafif uçan böcektir. Hafifliği ve ölçüsüz hareketi nedeniyle telaşlı ya da hafif bir insan için de benzetme olur.

facets.statement: Işığa veya ateşe yönelerek çevresinde çırpınan küçük uçan böcek.
Böceğin hafifliğine ve telaşlı hareketine benzetilen hafif insan.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar küçük uçan böceği, ışık veya ateş çevresindeki çırpınışını ve hafifliğini birlikte verir; insan için kullanılan benzetme bu hafiflikten doğar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Böceğin küçüklüğünü, uçuşunu ve ışık ya da ateşe yönelen çırpınışını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Küçük uçan böcek, ışığa yönelme ve çırpınma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir erkeği hafifliği veya telaşlı davranışı bakımından böceğe benzeten kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: İnsana aktarılan hafiflik ve ölçüsüz hareket benzetmesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ışığa veya ateşe uçan küçük güve

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ışık ve ateş çevresindeki çırpınışla, komşu dal ise su yüzeyindeki uçuş ortamıyla ayrılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli küçük böceği ve onun ışık çevresindeki davranışını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kuşları, uçma eylemini ve havadaki genel hafiflik ya da hızı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal havada hafif ve hızlı hareket etme özelliğine dayanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir canlı ve davranıştır; komşu dal ise canlı türünden bağımsız genel uçuş ve havadaki hafiflik alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uçan küçük böceğin kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kuşun yere yakın biçimde kanatlarını açıp çırpması eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: uçan böcek ile kuşun kanat çırpışı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kanatlı bir canlının çırpınarak hareket ettiği sahneyi paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal canlı adı, komşu dal ise kuşun belirli bir hareketidir; ortaklık yalnız uçuş sahnesindedir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; böceğin türünü genel uçuş, başka küçük böcekler ve kuş hareketinden ayıran üç aday seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الفراش الذي يطير ويتهافت في الضوء أو النار، وتشبيه الغوغاء أو الناس به، وفراشة الرجل الخفيف
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الفراش المفروش ولا فراش الرأس ولا فراشة القفل إلا على تشبيه الرقة أو الخفة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الفراش هذا الذي يطير وسمي بذلك لخفته؛ الفراشة الرجل الخفيف (maqayis)؛ الفراش التي تطير طالبة للضوء؛ يقال للخفيف من الرجال فراشة (ayn)؛ الفراشة التي تطير وتهافت في السراج؛ أطيش من فراشة (sihah)؛ الفراش ما تراه كصغار البق يتهافت في النار؛ الفراش الذي يطير؛ الخفيف من الرجال فراشة (tahdhib)؛ الفراش طير معروف؛ كالفراش المبثوث (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kuşun yere veya bir şeyin üzerine yaklaşarak kanatlarını açıp çırpmasını açıkça tanımlar; yavrularının üzerinde bunu yapan kuş örneği çekirdeği somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bir kuş hareketidir; uçan böceğin adı ya da insanın kendine döşek sermesi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın hareketi kuşun kanatlarını açması, çırpması ve yere ya da hedefe yaklaşması koşullarıyla sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kuşun yere veya belirli bir şeyin üzerine yaklaşırken kanatlarını açıp art arda çırpmasıdır.

facets.statement: Kuşun kanatlarını açıp çırparak yere veya bir hedefin üzerine yaklaşması.
Bir kuşun yavrularının üzerinde kanat çırpması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kuşun kanatlarını açıp çırpması ile yere ya da bir şeyin üzerine yaklaşmasını aynı hareket içinde birleştirir; yavrular üzerinde çırpınma buna örnektir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kuşun kanatlarını açarak yere veya hedefe yakın biçimde çırpması eylemini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kuş katılımcısını, kanat açmayı, çırpmayı ve yakınlık koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuşun yavrularına yaklaşarak veya onların üzerinde kanatlarını açıp çırptığı örnekte kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hedefin yavrular olduğu özel kanat çırpma sahnesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin çevresinde ya da genel olarak havada kanat hareketini daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kuşun kanatlarını art arda hareket ettirmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yere ya da hedefe yakınlaşan, kanatların yayıldığı özel hareketi; komşu dal ise daha genel kanat çırpmayı karşılar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kuşun yaptığı belirli kanat açma ve çırpma hareketidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Işık veya ateş çevresinde uçan küçük böceğin adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kanatlı canlıların çırpınan hareketiyle ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal eylemi, komşu dal canlıyı adlandırır; kuş ve böcek katılımcıları da farklıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; özel kuş hareketini genel kanat çırpmadan ve uçan böcek adından ayıran iki karşılaştırma seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تفرش الطائر إذا رفرف بجناحيه وبسطهما أو قرب من الأرض، ومنه الحمرة التي تفرش على فرخيها
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الفراش اسما للحشرة، ولا بسط الإنسان فراشا لنفسه
branches.source_phrase_ar: تفرش الطائر إذا قرب من الأرض ورفرف بجناحه؛ فجاءت الحمرة تفرش (maqayis)؛ تفرش الطائر رفرف بجناحيه وبسطهما (sihah)؛ فرش الطائر تفريشا إذا جعل يرفرف على الشيء وهي الشرشرة والرفرفة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi bedenin altına yayma, kolları yere serme ve bedeni yere bastırma çekirdeğini verir; yola girme ve bacakları ayırma kullanımları yüzeye yayılma imgesinden doğan ayrı uzantılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bedenin veya uzuvların yüzeye yayılmasıyla ilgilidir; evlilik mecazı, kuşun kanat çırpışı ve evi eşya ile döşeme anlamları dışarıdadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bedensel yayılma çekirdeğini korur; altına örtü alma, yolu kullanma, birini devirip altına alma ve bacakları açma anlamları kendi yapılarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yüzeyi bedenin altına almak veya bedeni ve uzuvları o yüzey üzerine yaymaktır. Bu hareket, birini yere devirip altına alma, bir yolu kullanma ve bacakları birbirinden ayırma gibi yapılarda özel anlamlar kazanır.

facets.statement: Toprağı veya örtüyü bedenin altına almak ve beden ya da kolları yüzeye yaymak.
Birini yere devirerek altına almak veya üzerine basmak.
Bir yolu üzerine yayılır gibi kullanıp ilerlemek.
Bacakları açarak birbirinden uzaklaştırmak.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bedenin altına yüzey alma ve kolları yere yayma çekirdeğini verir; devirip altına alma, yolda ilerleme ve bacakları açma bu mekânsal düzenin özel uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bedenin altına bir yüzey alma ile kolları veya bedeni o yüzeye serme çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Beden, uzuv, alt yüzey ve yayılma ilişkisini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiyi yere düşürüp onun üzerine çıkan özelleşmiş kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Devirme sonucunu ve üstün konumdaki kişinin altta kalanı bastırmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir şeyin yüzeye açılıp yayılması biçimini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda yayılan beden ya da uzuvdur; komşu dalda ise hazırlanan nesne, örtü veya zemindir.
